escalation: Two anchors point at the wrong member of a shared consonantal skeleton (both arrived as niqqud-twin-target hints and both are accepted). (a) Pi. sense: '(ref. to חרש, Josh. II, 1)' targets חָרַשׁ I (H01777, a verb entry whose lead sense is the bare '(b. h.)' etymology); the midrash the sentence quotes reads the word as חָרָשׁ 'carpenter/artisan' (H01780) — the whole passage is about men pretending to be carpenters — and the plain-sense alternative is חֶרֶשׁ (H01782). (b) Nif. sense: '(cmp. אָגַר I, a. משך)' in a Hebrew entry glossing 'to be conducted in gutters' targets the Aramaic מְשַׁךְ I (M02892); the intended lemma is the Hebrew משַׁךְ (M02891, 'to draw ... to conduct'), which the Tosefta quote's own נמשכין presupposes. M02891's headword string is mis-pointed (initial mem unpointed), so it is unreachable by exact match: 0 of 22 corpus anchors on this skeleton reach it and 11 displays spelled correctly מָשַׁךְ all land on מְשַׁךְ I. Third hint (גרר -> גָּרַר I) REJECTED: גָּרַר I 'to drag, scrape' is the right member for נָגַר 'to carry along, roll / to scrape'. Repair needs new href/data-ref bytes and a maintainer ruling on which member each anchor means.

Two wrong link targets. (a) Sense —2) '(interch. with נגד)' resolves to אִינְגַּד (A01369, the Git. 58ᵃ idiom 'go further!'), not to the Aramaic verb נְגַד (N00118) that the sentence names; the same entry links 'v. נְגַד' correctly two senses later, an internal control. Corpus-wide every one of the 11 unpointed 'נגד' displays lands on אִינְגַּד while all 37 pointed displays (נְגַד/נָגַד/נֶגֶד) resolve to their own headword. (b) Sense —3) 'Targ. Job XL, 23 (ed. Lag. a. oth. נגיד)' targets נָגִיד I 'leader, ruler' (N00152); in a sense glossed 'to run along, flow' the variant reading is the participle/adjective נְגִיד (N00154, 'c. (נְגַד)'). Arrived as a niqqud-twin-target hint; accepted. Both need new attribute bytes.

content.senses[0] is an object with no keys at all ({}), carrying neither number, definition, grammar nor nested senses, ahead of correctly numbered 1) and —2) siblings. No patch op addresses a sense with no definition string (its anchor is the empty-string sha, e3b0c442), and deleting it would destroy the only evidence of whatever the slot once held. Matches the catalogued empty-lead-sense population; flagged, not repaired.

Three anchors in the stem-head run ', ch. Pa. נַדֵּב, Ithpa. אִתְנַדֵּב, אִינַּ׳ same' point at unrelated headwords. (a) display אִתְנַדֵּב (the Ithpa. of this entry's own root) -> נְגֵב, one consonant from the host נְדַב and semantically unrelated ('to dry'); this is the catalogued binyan-head-form-mislinked shape, whose audit found the target one consonant from the HOST headword in 103 of 137 members. (b) display אִינַּ׳ (abbreviating אִינַּדֵּב, the second Ithpa. form named in the same breath) -> נוּם 'to slumber'; the target does not begin with the abbreviated consonants. (c) display מִתְנַ׳ (abbreviating the מִתְנַדְּבִין of the following Targum quotation) -> מִתְנָא 'a gift', a word that merely shares the opening letters. All three need new attribute bytes; (a) and (b) also need a maintainer ruling on whether a stem-head form should link to its own entry at all.

'אשיאן בר נדבך (Ms. M. נדבר)' — the manuscript variant of the proper name Nidbakh is linked to דָּבַר 'to speak' (the skeleton נדבר has no entry, so the resolver stripped the initial nun and matched the root). The text presents נדבר as a variant spelling of a name, not as a form of דבר, so the link asserts a lexical identity the entry denies. Note the null model: root-fallback linking of a prefixed form to its bare root is the corpus norm (201 occurrences, mostly correct), so the defect here is the semantic case, not the mechanism — a maintainer call between re-targeting and unlinking.

Class-8 truncation in the etymology parenthetical: it cites 'Del. Prol.' twice where the corpus writes 'Del. Proleg.' 19 times and 'Del. Prol.' only in these two spots. Restoring the abbreviation needs bytes that are not in the entry, so it cannot be repaired here — needs the printed page. (The entry's rare-dotted-variant hint proposed 'Prov.' as the dominant sibling; REJECTED — 'Prov.' is the book of Proverbs, an unrelated token. The real comparison is Proleg./Prol.) P000003 separately removes the duplicated 'v. Del. Prol.; ' copy; that delete is independent of the abbreviation question.

Plural anchor: display נִי׳ — the entry's own abbreviated plural, also carried verbatim in plural_form — resolves to מני (M01772, 'to count'), a headword that does not begin with the abbreviated consonants. Corpus-wide נִי׳ resolves to מני in 23 of 23 occurrences across 23 unrelated N-letter hosts, so this is a member of the catalogued geresh-abbrev-fixed-sink family rather than a one-off; a reviewer can dispose of it with that row. Repair needs new attribute bytes.
